info.title: CodeExplorer CLI — Architecture Intelligence & MCP Code Graph
info.description: Architecture Intelligence & Embedded Code Graph Engine for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) and engineering teams. CodeExplorer (ce) parses polyglot codebases (C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Kotlin, Python, Go, Rust, SQL, ColdFusion), compiles a fast local SQLite code graph, provides an OpenCypher query engine, serves a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and enforces architectural guardrails with Semantic Invariant Gates (SIG).
